description: Turn titles into clean URL slugs, one slug per non-empty line (bulk). Folds accents (é → e, ß → ss), transliterates Arabic to Latin (the article al- becomes its own word) or keeps Arabic letters, converts Arabic-Indic digits, drops tashkeel, turns & into "and", can remove stop words (English and Arabic) and cap the length at a word boundary. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/slugify/

foldAccents.description: Transliterate accents: é → e, ß → ss, æ → ae (default true).

maxLength.description: Maximum slug length in characters, cut at a word boundary (0 = no limit).

removeStopWords.description: Remove stop words in English and Arabic such as the, of, and (kept if nothing else is left).

separator.description: Word separator: dash (default), underscore or dot.

text.description: Title(s) to slugify. Each non-empty line becomes one slug.

name: text_slugify
title: Slugify
